description: This file contains unit tests for the data asset management system, specifically testing the behavior of dependency-safe delete operations in a database-backed environment. It verifies that deleting an asset with properties (children) soft deletes the associated records properly.

classes.name: DbBackedDependencySafeDeleteTests
classes.description: A test class that validates safe delete behavior for assets with dependencies in the database.

methods.name: Delete_asset_with_properties_soft_deletes_children_and_asset
methods.description: A test method that creates an asset with properties, deletes the asset via API, and asserts that the asset and its properties are properly soft deleted and no longer retrievable.
